page_title: BAY 3-1 AUG | Bayern Munich v Augsburg 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+4' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+3' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg. The ball is out of play and Augsburg manage to earn a corner.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Unlucky! A great strike from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
87' Daniel Siebert sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
87' The Augsburg players halt their celebrations as referee Daniel Siebert makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

86' 3 - 1 Dion Beljo (Augsburg) runs on to a clever pass from Ermedin Demirovic and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He still has work to do but finishes with aplomb into the back of the net.

86' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
83' The referee can't ignore those comments and Ryan Gravenberch (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow card for bad language.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Robert Gumny (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Arne Engels.
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich). Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
82' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
81' The manager makes a subsitution with Ryan Gravenberch (Bayern Munich) coming on for Kingsley Coman.
81' Thomas Tuchel has decided to make a change. Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) replaces Min-Jae Kim.
80' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and Daniel Siebert immediately signals a free kick.
79' What was Irvin Cardona (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
79' The attendance for today's match is 75000.
76' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.

76' Arne Engels (Augsburg) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
75' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Serge Gnabry walks off the pitch to be replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).
70' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leroy Sane.
70' Here is a change. Noussair Mazraoui is going off and Thomas Tuchel gives the last tactical orders to Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
69' 3 - 0 Goal! Alphonso Davies gets to the ball, slips Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:0.
68' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) squanders a great opportunity after striking the ball onto the post!
66' Here's the change. Ruben Vargas leaves the pitch and Irvin Cardona (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
66' The substitution is prepared. Dion Beljo (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sven Michel.
66' Enrico Maassen prepares a substitution. Mergim Berisha is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
66' Today's match ends for Elvis Rexhbecaj who will be replaced by Tim Breithaupt (Augsburg).
65' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
64' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
64' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) will take a corner kick.

64' Finn Dahmen pulls off a brilliant save! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved. The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.
63' Half-chance! Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

62' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
61' A cross into the box from Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
61' Daniel Siebert has a clear sight and sees a foul from Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).
60' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
59' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
58' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
57' Rough tackle by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
52' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
52' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
50' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar.
48' Sven Michel (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
45+2' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Siebert had a clear view and blows his whistle. Free kick. Augsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45+2' What an opportunity! Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
44' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
43' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniel Siebert blows for a foul.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Finn Dahmen.
40' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
40' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bayern Munich!

39' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Siebert must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayern Munich using VAR. This could be interesting!
38' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!

37' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
36' Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
32' 1 - 0 What an unlucky own goal by Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg)!
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mergim Berisha (Augsburg) heads on.
29' The corner by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

28' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen was alert and made a comfortable save. It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
27' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
26' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle and it's Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
23' The ball is cleared after Arne Engels (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
19' The ball is played back to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg), who controls it instantly and releases a piledriver from long range, but the shot lacks accuracy and drifts well wide of the left post.
18' Arne Engels (Augsburg) takes the corner with a short pass.
17' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
16' Niklas Dorsch (Augsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
15' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

14' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Finn Dahmen reads it well and gathers the ball.
13' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
12' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
11' The linesman signals that Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
10' Arne Engels (Augsburg) sends a lofted pass into the penalty area from a free kick, but the opposition's defence manages to control all the attacking players and thwart the threat.
9' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
8' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Finn Dahmen comes off the line to clear the ball away.
6' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
5' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
4' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
2' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
1' The match has just started.
